summary.scope: frozen-code holdout; synthetic supplied fixtures; mocked provider and DB
summary.independence_notice: This score is independent only for the fixed commit and preregistered rules; after holdout-informed code or grader changes, a fresh holdout is required.
limitations: The provider is stubbed with five supplied synthetic candidates, then the real relevantItems filter runs; no Coupang or ADPICK HTTP or production rate limiter is exercised.
Search handler, relevance ranking, product gate, and real saveProducts logic run against a mocked DB.
Fixture target recall is limited to known synthetic candidates, not catalog or service recall.
Synthetic titles and prices are artificial; latency excludes real providers and databases.
Questions reuse eight templates across 15 holdout categories; scores are not population estimates.
Missing evidence is UNVERIFIED; a displayed unknown never counts as correct.
